question: Which of the following buttons are present in the Quick Access Toolbar by default in MS-Word 2010?
solution:
**The correct answer is Save, Undo, Redo ​ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__

__
 
• The Quick Access Toolbar on the top left corner of the MS-Word 2010 consists of Save options__.
 
• The Quick Access Toolbar is located next to the Microsoft Office button.
 
 
• It is a customizable toolbar that comes with a set of independent commands.
 
• It gives you quick access to commonly used commands like save, undo, redo etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eed28ee14a7b96ad904cefaea49299b68e89f6d0a0705d4d06a346a3d0042a7.png]
